builder.prompt_text_edu_1:
Generate a professional education description for my [Major] [Degree] from [Institution].

Include:
- Degree: [Degree]
- Major: [Major]
- Institution: [Institution]
- Location: [Location]
- Graduation Date: [Date]
- Coursework/Honors: [List key courses or honors]

Focus on:
- Academic achievements
- Relevant coursework
- Research or thesis
- Leadership in student organizations
- Awards and scholarships
builder.prompt_text_edu_2:
Improve this education description to make it more professional and impactful:

[Paste your current description here]

Focus on:
- Highlighting key achievements or honors
- Emphasizing acquired skills
- Including relevant coursework or projects
- Ensuring clarity and conciseness
builder.prompt_tailor_edu_desc: Customize your education for the target job
builder.prompt_text_edu_3:
Rewrite this education description to highlight skills and knowledge relevant to [Target Role]:

Current description:
[Paste your current description here]

Target Role: [e.g. Data Scientist, Software Engineer]

Focus on transferable skills and relevant coursework.
builder.prompt_add_honors_desc: Quantify and highlight your academic achievements
builder.prompt_text_edu_4:
Enhance this education description by adding specific achievements and honors:

Current description:
[Paste your current description here]

Consider including:
- Academic honors (Dean's List, Cum Laude)
- GPA if above 3.5
- Class ranking
- Research publications
- Competitions won
builder.ai_tip_1: • Click 'Copy' to copy the prompt template

builder.ai_tip_3: • Paste the prompt and replace bracketed content with your info
builder.ai_tip_4: • Review and personalize the AI-generated content
builder.ai_tip_5: • Iterate if needed - be specific about what to improve
builder.exp_ai_prompt:
You are a top recruiter and resume expert. Based on the following target job description (JD), concisely rewrite the following work experience.

[Formatting Requirements]:
1. Extreme conciseness: Each bullet point must be strictly condensed, limited to a single line (about 15-20 English words), no line breaks.
2. Quantity limit: Output exactly the 3 most impressive bullet points.
3. Professional tone: Start with strong action verbs (e.g. Led, Optimized, Improved) and include quantified data (e.g. 30%, 100k times).
4. Direct output: Only return the bulleted list starting with '• ', no introductions, conclusions, or extra tags.
builder.exp_ai_no_jd: Not provided, please generate professional experience description based on title and company
builder.exp_ai_error: Experience optimization failed, please try again later.
builder.exp_desc_placeholder:

builder.experience_subtitle: Add your work experience. Start with the most recent position, you can drag to reorder.
builder.skill_ai_prompt:
You are a professional resume optimization expert. Based on the following target JD, recommend 3-8 core skills the user might have that are highly relevant to the position.
Return a JSON array of strings, e.g. ["React", "Node.js", "Communication"]. Do not include any other explanation.
builder.skill_ai_no_jd: Not provided, please recommend common professional skills
builder.skill_ai_error: Skill recommendation failed, please try again later.
builder.skills_subtitle: Add your key skills. Include hard and soft skills relevant to your target position.
builder.skill_tip_1: • Include hard skills (tools, languages) and soft skills (leadership, communication)
builder.skill_tip_3: • Ensure your skills match the job requirements
builder.skill_tip_4: • Be honest about your proficiency level
builder.summary_ai_prompt:
You are a professional resume writer.
Based on the following target JD and the user's skills and stories, write a professional summary of 50-150 words.
Return plain text only, no Markdown, no explanations.
builder.summary_ai_no_jd: Not provided, please generate a general professional summary based on skills
builder.summary_ai_error: Summary generation failed, please try again later.
builder.summary_subtitle: Write a short overview of your professional background, core skills, and career goals. Keep it concise - ideally 3-4 sentences.
builder.summary_placeholder: Example: Results-driven Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications. Specializes in React, Node.js, and cloud technologies. Proven track record in delivering high-quality solutions, improving user experience, and driving business growth. Seeking to leverage technical expertise and leadership skills in a senior development role.
builder.senior_example: "Accomplished Marketing Manager with 8+ years of experience driving successful campaigns for Fortune 500 companies. Specializes in digital marketing, brand strategy, and team leadership. Consistently exceeded targets by 30% through data-driven strategies and creative problem-solving."
builder.junior_example: "Recent Computer Science graduate with internship experience at tech startups. Solid foundation in full-stack development and passionate about building user-friendly applications. Eager to contribute technical skills and innovative perspectives to a forward-thinking development team."
builder.career_changer_example: "Experienced Educator transitioning to UX Design, holding a Google UX Design Professional Certificate. Excellent communication skills, empathy for user needs, and dedicated to creating intuitive digital experiences. Completed 3 portfolio projects showcasing the design thinking process."
